rules.name: skill interval collapses
rules.test: 90% interval on Brier skill vs the price has a lower bound < 0
rules.rationale: 50 settled bets is the smallest sample at which the interval has any power at realistic edges.

rules.name: stop-loss
rules.rationale: About four times the best backtest ROI in the run, so a live -10% is not the same scale of noise.

rules.name: hit rate below break-even
rules.test: hit rate < price-implied break-even - 2 standard errors
rules.rationale: 100 bets is the smallest sample at which a 2-SE gap can resolve a 2-point edge.

rules.name: losing streak
rules.rationale: Roughly the 1-in-500 point of a fair sequence at the prices these rules take; fires before D2 can.

rules.name: definition drift
rules.test: the rule text or inputs differ from the registration commit
rules.rationale: A rule whose text changed after its result was seen is a new rule and must start at paper.

repromotion.requires: a fresh prospective sample, 200 settled bets, clearing D1-D3 in the opposite direction
repromotion.why: The same sample that demoted a strategy cannot also promote it; that is the definition of chasing.
